changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Make flowerbiz sales templates executable through the Trino federated entry after PostgreSQL numeric columns are exposed as varchar.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE copilot_ai.nl2sql_query_template SET sql_template = $tpl$SELECT s."项目", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(s."销售金额全口径" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) AS "销售金额", SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(s."销售单数" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS "销售单数", SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(s."赠送单数" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS "赠送单数" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_sale_summary s WHERE s."业务月份" = :month GROUP BY s."项目" ORDER BY "销售金额" DESC LIMIT :top_n$tpl$, updated_at = now() WHERE template_code = 'TPL-37';
UPDATE copilot_ai.nl2sql_query_template SET sql_template = $tpl$SELECT s."业务月份", s."项目", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(s."销售金额全口径" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) AS "销售金额", SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(s."销售单数" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS "销售单数", SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(s."赠送单数" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS "赠送单数", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(s."赠送成本全口径" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) AS "赠送成本" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_sale_summary s WHERE s."年份" = :year GROUP BY s."业务月份", s."项目" ORDER BY s."业务月份", "销售金额" DESC LIMIT 200$tpl$, updated_at = now() WHERE template_code = 'TPL-52';
